[SWS_PHM_00229] Switch Global Supervision Status from kFAILED to kSTOPPED
⌈
If the Global Supervision Status is kFAILED, the Elemen-
tary Supervision Status of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervi-
sion is kEXPIRED, the expiredSupervisionTolerance is configured to zero and
the GlobalSupervision corresponds to Operating System, Execution Manage-
ment or State Management, then the Platform Health Management shall change the Global Supervision Status to kSTOPPED.
⌋
